title: PerspectiveLockMod
description: Lock and control the player's perspective (first/third person) from the server.
body:
🇬🇧 English – Mod Description
Perspective Lock is a lightweight mod that gives server owners full control over the player's camera perspective. Whether you're building immersive roleplay, polished minigames, or strict PvP environments, this mod lets you lock the player's view in first person, third person back, or front view — and prevent them from switching with F5.

🌟 Features:

Server-controlled camera lock

Supports first-person, third-person back, and front views

Prevents camera switching with F5 when locked

Clean integration with custom server-side commands

Perfect for cinematic experiences, maps, and competitive games

Client-side mod with plugin support required.

🇪🇸 Español – Descripción del Mod
Perspective Lock es un mod liviano que permite a los servidores controlar por completo la perspectiva de cámara del jugador. Ideal para mapas personalizados, minijuegos o entornos competitivos, este mod te permite bloquear la vista en primera persona, tercera persona trasera o frontal — impidiendo que el jugador cambie de vista con F5.

🌟 Características:

Bloqueo de cámara controlado desde el servidor

Compatible con primera persona, tercera trasera y vista frontal

Evita que el jugador cambie de perspectiva con F5 al estar bloqueado

Integración limpia mediante comandos del servidor

Perfecto para experiencias cinemáticas, mapas y PvP

Requiere mod del lado cliente y soporte mediante plugin.
